instruction.text: Build the portrait of King Edward.

feedback.end: King Edward ruled England from 1042 to 1066.

instruction.text: Listen and select the correct answer.

feedback.end: This created a big problem as there were three people who wanted to be the next King of England.

atoms.a: When King Edward died in 1066, he didn’t have any children. Why do you think this was a problem?

b.sound: There was no clear, heir to the throne.
The royal painter hadn’t finished his portrait.

feedback.finish: These three leaders all wanted to rule England. It was a big competition!

atoms.b: Harold Godwinson became the next King of ((++England Kingland)).
This was because he was a powerful ((++earl Viking)) and had the support of other English nobles.

feedback.finish: However, Harold Godwinson was not safe. William and Harald Hardrada weren’t going to accept the decision!

instruction.text: Select Stamford Bridge on the map to find out what happened.

atoms.b: Harald Hardrada ((++sailed ran)) from Norway with his Viking army.
King Harold’s army met them at Stamford Bridge, and there was a big ((++battle picnic)).
King Harold’s army won, and the Vikings ((++left invaded)) England.

feedback.end: However, King Harold didn’t have time to rest as another enemy was coming!
